newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine public services consumption up 16.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentine public services consumption up 16.1 pct.

text.p: Argentine consumption of public services rose by 16.1 percent in June from the same month a year earlier, the Economy Ministry said Thursday.
The rise in the first half of the year, as measured by the ministry's public services indicator, came to 13.3 percent compared with the same period a year earlier, the ministry said in a statement.
Public services consumption in June rose 2.3 percent from a month earlier.
The indictor measures the levels of electricity generation, gas production, water distribution, transport and telecommunications.
